_about: What each harness of kiln plan 01a1cd8e862e7169a074db3d5fa33f3d (steps 19-28) does through kiln's UI and API, on the host and in a microVM of its own, and each gap with its cited reason (step 35: 'each harness works as on the host, or its gap is listed with a cited reason'). Flags: linux_build (kiln ships an Agentfile pinning its Linux build); mcp (kiln gives it kiln's MCP server on the host, so an MCP round trip and an agent started from where it runs apply there); mcp_in_microvm (kiln gives it kiln's MCP server in a microVM, over HTTP as step 18 forms it: on a runner's machine once runners serve it on their loopback, plan 01a1d2c16eb074f19cf7ae7f1025c0be step 3; null: not recorded yet, so the drive tries it); resume (kiln takes its conversation up again: spec.resume, agents_start's resume, an ended agent's Restart); ui_pick_up (the composer's past sessions list its conversations, to pick one up after its agent was ended). Every flag that is false or null has a gap naming it ({what, where, why, cites}); each caveat is {note, cites}; sources back the row's reason, its pin first. A cite is a URL; kiln's code by the text it holds (path#text: its lines move); or a recorded evidence file's line (docs/research/...:line). Held to kiln's code and to its sources by vm_e2e/step35.rs's checks.

gaps.why: Antigravity reads MCP servers only from its own config files: its global one, which in a microVM is in the person's volume, shared by their sessions, and its workspace's, which is the person's project; neither is a place for one session's own token (step 18). agy 1.5.7 expands no ${VAR} in a server's header and takes no MCP server by --settings, so neither carries a token per session. A stdio server it starts does get its environment: a stdio server in the shared config, holding no token, can take each session's own from it, plan 01a1d2c16eb074f19cf7ae7f1025c0be step 4's way once step 18's isolated launch is on kiln main. Until then, no MCP round trip and no agent started from inside.
